title: Station and airport announcements
goal: Catch the key information in station, airport and metro announcements: destination, time, track or gate, delays and cancellations.

items.fr: Le train partira de la voie 14.

drills.explain: Futur simple: infinitive + -a for il / elle: [[commencera]].

drills.en: The train will leave from track 14.

drills.prompt: “Passengers will be able to take the next bus.”
options: Les passagers pourront prendre le prochain autobus.
Les passagers pouvont prendre le prochain autobus.
Les passagers pourra prendre le prochain autobus.
drills.explain: pouvoir has the irregular future stem pourr-; ils → -ont: [[pourront]].

items.en: delayed / cancelled: agreement with the noun

drills.en: The connection to Halifax is cancelled.
The flights to Toronto are delayed.

options: Le train de 18 h est annulé.
Le train de 18 h est annulée.
Le train de 18 h a annulé.
drills.explain: [[train]] is masculine singular: [[annulé]]. [[a annulé]] would mean the train cancelled something.

example.fr: Le vol pour Vancouver part à 19 h 40.
example.en: The flight to Vancouver leaves at 7:40 p.m.
Boarding will begin in ten minutes.

example.fr: L'embarquement se fera à la porte 52.
Le train pour Québec part de la voie 14.
example.en: The train to Québec City leaves from track 14.

example.fr: Attendez sur le quai, derrière la ligne jaune.
example.en: Wait on the platform, behind the yellow line.

example.fr: Notre vol est retardé d'une heure.
example.en: Our flight is delayed by an hour.

accept: Mesdames et messieurs, votre attention, s'il vous plaît.

steps.title: A day of announcements
steps.intro: Sofia travels from Montréal to Vancouver to visit her brother. Listen to what she hears on the way. Play each one, try to catch **where, when, which gate or track**, then reveal the transcript.

blocks.title: 1. In the metro
blocks.context: Sofia takes the green line to go downtown.
blocks.fr: Prochaine station : Berri-UQAM. Correspondance avec les lignes orange et jaune.
blocks.en: Next station: Berri-UQAM. Connection with the orange and yellow lines.

blocks.title: 2. At Montréal airport: check-in hall
blocks.fr: Mesdames et messieurs, votre attention, s'il vous plaît. Le vol 412 à destination de Vancouver est retardé en raison du mauvais temps. Le nouveau départ est prévu à 19 h 40. L'embarquement se fera à la porte 52.
blocks.en: Ladies and gentlemen, your attention, please. Flight 412 to Vancouver is delayed because of bad weather. The new departure is scheduled for 7:40 p.m. Boarding will be at gate 52.

blocks.title: 3. At the gate
blocks.fr: Les passagers du vol 412 à destination de Vancouver sont priés de se présenter à la porte 52. L'embarquement commencera dans dix minutes. Les familles avec de jeunes enfants pourront embarquer en premier.
blocks.en: Passengers on flight 412 to Vancouver are asked to go to gate 52. Boarding will begin in ten minutes. Families with young children will be able to board first.

blocks.title: 4. Last call
blocks.fr: Dernier appel pour monsieur Karim Haddad, passager du vol 806 à destination de Paris. Embarquement immédiat, porte 55.
blocks.en: Final call for Mr. Karim Haddad, passenger on flight 806 to Paris. Immediate boarding, gate 55.

blocks.title: 5. Meanwhile, at Gare Centrale
blocks.context: Sofia's friend Olivier is taking the train to Québec City.
blocks.fr: Le train 24 à destination de Québec, avec arrêts à Drummondville, Charny et Sainte-Foy, partira de la voie 14 à 15 h 30. Les passagers peuvent maintenant descendre sur le quai.
blocks.en: Train 24 to Québec City, with stops in Drummondville, Charny and Sainte-Foy, will leave from track 14 at 3:30 p.m. Passengers may now go down to the platform.

blocks.body: Don't try to understand every word. Announcements always follow the same order, so listen for the **slots**: which train or flight, where to, what happens (on time, delayed, cancelled), when, and where (track, gate).

blocks.title: The five slots
blocks.body:
Almost every announcement fills the same slots:

- **Attention:** [[Mesdames et messieurs, votre attention, s'il vous plaît.]]
- **Which one:** [[le vol 412]], [[le train 24]], [[l'autobus de 12 h 30]]
- **Where to / from:** [[à destination de Vancouver]] (going to), [[en provenance de Toronto]] (coming from)
- **What happens:** [[est à l'heure]] (on time), [[est retardé]] (delayed), [[est annulé]] (cancelled)
- **When and where:** [[à 19 h 40]], [[porte 52]], [[voie 14]]

If you catch slots 2 to 5, you have everything you need.

blocks.title: Announcements love the futur simple
blocks.pattern: le train / le vol + partira, arrivera, commencera, se fera…
blocks.note: You learned the futur simple in unit 4. Announcements use it constantly, so listen for the **-ra** ending: it means *will*. Also note [[est prévu à]] = is scheduled for.

examples.fr: Le train partira de la voie 14.
examples.en: The train will leave from track 14.
Boarding will begin in ten minutes.

examples.fr: Les passagers pourront prendre l'autobus de 17 h 15.
examples.en: Passengers will be able to take the 5:15 p.m. bus.

blocks.title: Retardé and annulé agree like adjectives
head: delayed
cancelled
blocks.note: All four forms **sound the same**, so for listening you don't need to worry. In writing, match the noun.

blocks.body:
- **Retardé or en retard?** [[Le vol est retardé]] = the flight has been officially delayed (a new time). [[Je suis en retard]] = I am late. Both are possible for a train, but only people are [[en retard]] for an appointment.
- **À destination de vs en provenance de:** on an arrivals board, [[en provenance de Toronto]] means the plane is **coming from** Toronto. Many travellers mix them up.
- **Numbers:** flight and gate numbers are said as full numbers: [[le vol quatre cent douze]], [[la porte cinquante-deux]]. Watch out for [[soixante-douze]] (72) vs [[soixante-deux]] (62), and [[quatre-vingts]] (80).
- **Porte** is the word for an airport gate. [[La barrière]] is a barrier or a fence.

blocks.title: Announcements in two languages
blocks.body:
In airports, on VIA Rail trains and on Ottawa's O-Train, announcements are usually made in **French and English**. Use this: listen to the French first, then check yourself with the English.

In Montréal's metro, announcements are in French only. Listen for the station names, and remember that the line colours (**verte, orange, jaune, bleue**) are the easiest landmarks. You may hear [[bus]] or [[autobus]]; both are normal in Québec.

blocks.title: Why are announcements so formal?
blocks.body: Announcements use a **formal register** that you rarely hear in conversation: [[les passagers sont priés de…]] (passengers are kindly asked to…), [[en raison de]] (because of), [[se présenter à la porte]] (go to the gate). In everyday speech, you'd say [[à cause de]] and [[allez à la porte]]. You don't need to produce these forms, just recognize them.

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: Repeating announcements helps you hear their rhythm.

lines.fr: Le vol 412 à destination de Vancouver est retardé.
L'embarquement se fera à la porte 52.
Le train partira de la voie 14 à 15 h 30.
lines.en: The train will leave from track 14 at 3:30 p.m.

lines.tip: UQAM is said as one word: *u-kam*.

blocks.fr: Le vol 412 à destination de Vancouver est retardé en raison du mauvais temps. Le nouveau départ est prévu à 19 h 40.
blocks.en: Flight 412 to Vancouver is delayed because of bad weather. The new departure is scheduled for 7:40 p.m.
blocks.prompt: What time will Sofia's flight leave now?
blocks.explain: [[dix-neuf heures quarante]] = 19 h 40 = 7:40 p.m. 412 is the flight number.

blocks.fr: Le train 24 à destination de Québec partira de la voie 14 à 15 h 30.
blocks.en: Train 24 to Québec City will leave from track 14 at 3:30 p.m.
options: Track 14
Track 24
Track 4
Track 15
blocks.explain: [[voie quatorze]] = track 14. 24 is the train number, and [[quinze heures trente]] is the time.

blocks.fr: Dernier appel pour les passagers du vol 806 à destination de Paris. Embarquement immédiat, porte 55.
blocks.en: Final call for passengers on flight 806 to Paris. Immediate boarding, gate 55.
options: Go to gate 55 right now
Wait: boarding starts in 55 minutes
Go to gate 86
blocks.explain: [[Dernier appel]] = final call, and [[embarquement immédiat]] = boarding now. [[porte cinquante-cinq]] = gate 55.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.intro: Most of these are listening tasks. Play each recording no more than twice.

blocks.fr: L'autobus de 12 h 30 à destination de Rimouski est annulé. Les passagers pourront prendre l'autobus de 17 h 15.
blocks.en: The 12:30 bus to Rimouski is cancelled. Passengers will be able to take the 5:15 p.m. bus.
blocks.prompt: You had a ticket for the 12:30 bus. What happens?
options: It's cancelled; you can take the 5:15 p.m. bus.
It's delayed until 5:15 p.m.
It's cancelled; there are no more buses today.
It leaves from gate 17.
blocks.explain: [[annulé]] = cancelled. [[pourront prendre]] (futur simple of pouvoir) = will be able to take.

blocks.fr: Le vol en provenance de Toronto arrivera avec trente minutes de retard.
blocks.en: The flight from Toronto will arrive thirty minutes late.
blocks.prompt: You are waiting for a friend. What does the announcement say?
options: The flight from Toronto will be 30 minutes late.
The flight to Toronto will leave in 30 minutes.
The flight from Toronto has arrived.
blocks.explain: [[en provenance de]] = coming from. [[arrivera]] is the future: it hasn't arrived yet. [[avec trente minutes de retard]] = 30 minutes late.

blocks.fr: Prochaine station : Lionel-Groulx. Correspondance avec la ligne verte.
blocks.en: Next station: Lionel-Groulx. Connection with the green line.
blocks.prompt: You are on the orange line. What can you do at the next station?
options: Change to the green line
Change to a bus
Get out: it's the last station
blocks.explain: [[Correspondance avec la ligne verte]] = you can transfer to the green line. Lionel-Groulx is on the green and orange lines.

blocks.text: Le vol pour Calgary est ___ : il partira à 21 h au lieu de 18 h.
blocks.en: The flight to Calgary is delayed: it will leave at 9 p.m. instead of 6 p.m.
blocks.explain: It still leaves, just later: [[retardé]]. [[Annulé]] would mean it doesn't leave at all.

blocks.text: L'embarquement ___ à la porte 31. (se faire, futur simple)
blocks.explain: faire has the irregular future stem fer-: [[se fera]].

blocks.prompt: Which sentence means “The connection to Halifax is cancelled”?
options: La correspondance pour Halifax est annulée.
La correspondance pour Halifax est retardée.
Le vol en provenance de Halifax est annulé.
La correspondance pour Halifax est à l'heure.
optionFeedback: en provenance de = from Halifax, and it's a flight, not a connection.

blocks.prompt: Our train was delayed because of the snow.
accept: Notre train a été retardé à cause de la neige.
Notre train a été retardé en raison de la neige.
Notre train était retardé à cause de la neige.
Notre train était en retard à cause de la neige.
Notre train a eu du retard à cause de la neige.
Notre train a pris du retard à cause de la neige.
Notre train a été retardé par la neige.
blocks.explain: [[a été retardé]] = was delayed (one event). In speech, [[à cause de la neige]] is more natural than [[en raison de]].

blocks.fr: Le train partira de la voie 14 à 15 h 30.
accept: Le train partira de la voie quatorze à quinze heures trente.
Le train partira de la voie 14 à 15h30.
blocks.explain: [[partira]]: futur simple. You can write the numbers as digits.

blocks.prompt: Your friend calls you while you are at the airport. Explain the announcement you just heard: your flight to Vancouver is delayed because of the weather, the new departure time, and the gate. Say what you are going to do while you wait.
checklist: The reason: à cause du mauvais temps / de la neige
The new time: Il partira à… / Le départ est prévu à…
The gate: L'embarquement se fera à la porte…
Your plan: Je vais manger / lire / t'appeler…

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Allô, Lucie ? C'est Sofia. Je suis encore à l'aéroport. Mon vol pour Vancouver est retardé à cause du mauvais temps. Le nouveau départ est prévu à 19 h 40, et l'embarquement se fera à la porte 52. Alors, je vais manger quelque chose et lire un peu. J'arriverai à Vancouver très tard, mais mon frère viendra me chercher. Je t'écrirai quand j'arriverai !
models.en: Hello, Lucie? It's Sofia. I'm still at the airport. My flight to Vancouver is delayed because of the bad weather. The new departure is scheduled for 7:40 p.m., and boarding will be at gate 52. So I'm going to eat something and read a bit. I'll arrive in Vancouver very late, but my brother will come and pick me up. I'll write to you when I arrive!

blocks.prompt: Write a text to the person who is picking you up. Your train or bus is delayed or cancelled. Say what happened, your new arrival time, and where to meet.
checklist: What happened: Mon train est retardé / Mon autobus a été annulé
The reason, if you know it: à cause de…
Where to meet: Rendez-vous à la gare / devant la sortie…

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Salut Camille ! Mauvaise nouvelle : mon autobus de 12 h 30 a été annulé. Je prendrai l'autobus de 17 h 15, alors j'arriverai à Rimouski vers 21 h 15. Tu pourras venir me chercher à la gare d'autobus ? Désolée et merci ! Amira
models.en: Hi Camille! Bad news: my 12:30 bus was cancelled. I'll take the 5:15 p.m. bus, so I'll arrive in Rimouski around 9:15 p.m. Will you be able to pick me up at the bus station? Sorry and thanks! Amira

summary:
- Listen for the five slots of an announcement: which one, where to, what happens, when, where
- Understand [[à destination de]], [[en provenance de]], [[retardé]], [[annulé]], [[la voie]], [[la porte]], [[correspondance]]
- Recognize the futur simple in announcements: [[partira, commencera, se fera, pourront]]
- Tell someone that your trip is delayed or cancelled
